dialogue: Could you recommend a 5-day travel itinerary for 2 people starting in Charlotte and visiting 2 different cities in Louisiana from March 9th to March 13th, 2022? Our budget is $1500. We require accommodations that allow parties and offer private rooms, and we'd prefer not to travel by flight.

The other person traveling with me can’t comfortably manage an intercity transfer and needs to stay with me, so please change the trip from two cities to one, base us only in New Orleans, and switch from a private room to an entire apartment. Keeping us together matters more than visiting two cities or having party-friendly lodging, so I’m willing to give up the parties requirement and replan the trip around New Orleans.

agent_action.rationale: This plan keeps both travelers together, uses only New Orleans as the Louisiana base, avoids flights and intercity transfers, and selects a supported entire apartment with capacity for two and a four-night minimum. Lodging is $744 for four nights, the two supported driving routes total $114, and listed restaurant averages total up to $418 for two when conservatively treated as per-person costs, for $1,276 in known costs. Packed-food groceries, local fuel/parking, and attraction admission prices are not provided, so the final all-in cost cannot be verified; the known-cost cushion under the $1,500 budget is $224. The former party-friendly requirement was explicitly relinquished, and the selected apartment prohibits parties.
